title: Pouch Express — A Pelican's Pedal Power
description: A big white pelican pedals a scarlet bicycle, its enormous golden bill pointing the way. Hollow spoked wheels, swept black flight feathers, webbed feet on opposite pedals, a curved neck and a deep orange throat pouch make a sculptural model readable from both sides.

sections.name: Black flight feathers and wings on the grips
Golden bill and generous orange throat pouch
